shortDescription: implements rest api for aaa configuration

options.name: api_version
options.description: Configures (force) API version (vX.Y) for acces to the remote device.

options.name: command
options.description: Function name calls according to configuration required - choice config_radius_profile allows you to configure the switch's global radius server settings choice config_radius_server allows you to configure a radius server IP host choice config_radius_serverGroup allows you to configure a radius-server group with existing radius server hosts

options.name: config
options.description: To config or remove the required command

options.name: cppm_details
options.description: Username and password combination of CPPM which is used to login to CPPM to download user roles, dictionary should be in the form: {'username':'superman','password': 'arubAn3tw0rks'}

options.name: dead_time
options.description: The RADIUS server dead_time. dead_time cannot set when is_tracking_enabled is true. Input dead_time: null to reset the value. dead_time is indicated as null instead of '0' in CLI

options.name: dyn_autz_port
options.description: Configure the UDP port for dynamic authorization messages.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport. The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: is_tracking_enabled
options.description: The RADIUS server for if tracking is enabled. The flag is_tracking_enabled, cannot set to true when dead_time is configured

options.name: key
options.description: Used with config_radius_profile command, Configure the default authentication key for all RADIUS. Input key as empty string to reset the value

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port to use when building the connection to the remote device.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: radius_server_id
options.description: The unique ID of the RADIUS Profile.

options.name: retransmit_attempts
options.description: The RADIUS server retransmit attempts

options.name: retry_interval
options.description: The RADIUS server retry interval

options.name: server_group_name
options.description: the AAA Server Group name

options.name: server_ip
options.description: Used with config_radius_server or config_radius_serverGroup - Radius server hosts IP address. Minimum is 1 servers, and maximum is 3

options.name: shared_secret
options.description: Used with config_radius_server command - The Radius server secret key

options.name: ssh_keyfile
options.description: Specifies the SSH key to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is the path to the key used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_SSH_KEYFILE will be used instead.

options.name: time_window_type
options.description: Time window type

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds for communicating with the network device for either connecting or sending commands. If the timeout is exceeded before the operation is completed, the module will error.

options.name: tracking_uname
options.description: The RADIUS service tracking username

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: Configures use SSL (HTTPS) for access to the remote device.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Configures validation of certification for access to the remote device.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of the IP Address used  (V6 is not supported via REST)
